non_absence_rule: Unresearched, held, invalid, ambiguous and unresolved geometry states are research/representation states only; none imply historical absence.

research_state_definitions.label: Reviewed · bounded-supported
research_state_definitions.description: C1 research and adversarial replay completed with a bounded-supported outcome. This is not an intensity score.

research_state_definitions.label: Reviewed · inconclusive
research_state_definitions.description: C1 research and adversarial replay completed, but the exact frozen target/year/frame question remains inconclusive. This is not absence.

research_state_definitions.label: Planned · unresearched
research_state_definitions.description: Identity/time QA permits subject research, but slavery/coercion research has not been performed. This is not absence.

research_state_definitions.label: Held
research_state_definitions.description: Identity/time/frame QA blocks subject research until the issue is resolved. This is not absence and no substitute target is used.

research_state_definitions.label: Registered only · C0
research_state_definitions.description: Registered/research-state target only. C0 is never evidence of historical presence or absence.

temporal_state_definitions.label: Exact cross-section
temporal_state_definitions.description: A dated cross-section directly supports the selected anchor. This still does not imply spatial/legal uniformity.

temporal_state_definitions.label: Period-level support
temporal_state_definitions.description: Evidence supports the historical period containing the anchor, not an event observed exactly in that year.

temporal_state_definitions.label: Near-anchor / approximate
temporal_state_definitions.description: Evidence is close enough to the anchor for bounded display only with an explicit approximate label.

temporal_state_definitions.label: Selected-year truth unknown
temporal_state_definitions.description: The reviewed packet does not establish positive historical truth at the selected anchor.

temporal_state_definitions.label: No single selected-year territorial state
temporal_state_definitions.description: The frozen frame is an aggregate for which one territorial selected-year state would be misleading.

temporal_state_definitions.label: Unassessed · subject research not performed
temporal_state_definitions.description: The target has a frozen research anchor, but no C1 subject packet exists. The anchor is a research frame, not historical truth.
